snippet.title: Mistfall Hunter - Launch Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gyldenmist gathers, gyldblod pulses.

The time has come, fellow Gyldhunters. Seize your fate.
 
Mistfall Hunter launches at July 29 6PM (PT). Wishlist Now!
